variants.implementation: Use the existing pinned author source and current I/O-only configuration wrapper. Do not change any active or historical configuration. variants.purpose: Test the paper-known temperature default and inverse-frequency objective without overwriting the release control.

scientific_settings.anchor_normalization: sum(w_y * loss_i) / sum(w_y) over anchors with a same-class nonself partner

variants.implementation: Create a separate experiment variant and new output namespace. Load the unchanged release YAML, then apply an explicit variant configuration containing model.contrastive.temperature=0.05 and model.train_loader=${train_loader}. The nested alias supplies exactly the root training loader to the existing author weight loader. Keep model.contrastive.use_class_weights=true. The original train(cfg) still calls the original build_contrastive_model(cfg.model). A wrapper must fail before optimizer construction if the computed nonempty class weights do not equal the independently counted reference training labels. Never accept the author warning fallback as a successful weighted variant.
assertions: No query label or query ancestry truth is read when counting class weights.
Counters and the class-weight mapping are saved in a source-pinned variant receipt.
Temperature is exactly 0.05 and all class weights match N/(C*N_c).
The forward loss uses existing valid-anchor masking and Eq. 5 normalization.
All other numerical settings and same-parent observations remain identical to the release comparison.
An imbalanced synthetic reference-label check distinguishes weighted from uniform loss, including no-positive anchors, before any separately authorized scientific run.
variants.claim: Paper-default objective reconstruction, not a recovered original Table 1 run. The paper labels 0.05 a default and does not identify the actual historical run temperature.

variants.purpose: Resolve the literal paper corruption equation in a separate sensitivity arm.

scientific_settings.selected_replacement: Every selected non-special node token becomes MASK

variants.implementation: Implement a new local collator adapter with readable source. Reuse the unchanged author ARG dataset, vocabulary, padding, sampler and full corpus. Independently sample eligible node positions at 0.30 and replace every selected position by the existing MASK ID, leaving special tokens and padding excluded. Inject only this collator in a new variant. Keep the release arm unchanged. Treat validation masking as an explicitly declared choice because the paper does not specify its separate probability.
assertions: Every supervised position equals MASK in the input and carries its original target label.
Special and padding positions are never selected.
The same observed path arrays and vocabulary are used.
No hidden switch to the generic text SequencePacker occurs.

paper_known.query_operation: Project using frozen reference centering and axes

proposed_study_choices.reference_weighting: Each unique reference path receives equal weight
proposed_study_choices.decomposition: Float64 deterministic full SVD of centered references
proposed_study_choices.classifier: Nearest labeled class centroid in the ten-dimensional projected space
proposed_study_choices.centroid_weighting: Each path within a source class receives equal weight
proposed_study_choices.tie_rule: First class in frozen EUR, EAS, AFR order
proposed_study_choices.query_support: The same frozen 10,000 query raw-path focal records as every competitor

variants.implementation: Create a new evaluator module and recipe with every above choice serialized and hashed before query truth access. Fit only reference observations and known source labels. assertions: Changing query embeddings cannot change fitted reference mean, axes or centroids.
No query truth or query population ancestry labels reach fit().
A hand-constructed low-rank reference example verifies projection and tie behavior.
Predictions preserve the exact frozen raw-path registry, including equal truncated inputs.
